home.welcomeIntro: Pick your board and an image. We'll download it, write it to your SD card or USB drive, and verify it for you.
home.offlineHint: Flash from a local file or an image you downloaded earlier.

flash.systemDeviceWarning: Flashing this can destroy the running OS.
flash.confirmText: Take one last look before writing.
flash.confirmWarning: ALL DATA WILL BE PERMANENTLY ERASED
flash.dataWarning: All data on the selected device will be erased
flash.successHint: Your SD card is ready! You can safely remove it and insert it into your {{boardName}}.
flash.successHintCustom: Your SD card is ready! You can safely remove it.
flash.successHintQdl: Flash complete! The device is ready to boot.
flash.successHintVerifySkipped: Verification stopped, so the write wasn't checked.
flash.noShaMessage: This image has no SHA checksum, so the written data can't be verified. Flashing will continue anyway.

modal.searchEmptyHint: Try another name or clear the search.
modal.listEmptyHint: The list came back empty. Refresh to try again.
modal.boardUpdateRequiredHint: This board isn't supported by this version of Armbian Imager. Please update.
modal.noImagesHint: No images are published for this board right now.
modal.insertDevice: Insert an SD card or USB drive
modal.rollingBuildMessage: Rolling-release images are built automatically from the latest code. They can contain untested changes and bugs, so they may not boot or work correctly.
modal.communityBoardMessage: This board is maintained by the community, so its images may not boot or work correctly and support is limited. Use the official builds when you can.

device.qdlNotFound: No EDL device found. Put your board in EDL mode and connect via USB.
device.qdlInstructions: Place the jumper on the JCTL pins, then connect the USB-C cable.
device.qdlInstructionsButton: Hold the EDL button while powering on, then connect the USB cable.

errorDisplay.scanQrOrShare: Scan the QR code or share this link:

error.writeFailed: Writing to the device failed at {{offset}}. The device may be too small, failing, or the reader was disconnected. Try another card, reader, or port.
error.qdlDisconnected: Device disconnected during flash. Reconnect in EDL mode and retry.
error.qdlPermissionDenied: USB access denied. On Linux, install udev rules: echo 'SUBSYSTEM=="usb", ATTR{idVendor}=="05c6", ATTR{idProduct}=="9008", MODE="0666"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/51-qdl.rules && echo 'blacklist qcserial' | sudo tee /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-qcserial.conf && sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
error.qdlConnectionFailed: Couldn't connect to the EDL device. Make sure it's in EDL mode and connected via USB.
error.qdlAutoconfigFailed: Failed to apply the autoconfig profile to the QDL image.
error.autoconfigNotArmbian: This image has no Armbian first-boot setup, so the profile can't be applied. Flash it without a profile or pick an Armbian image.
error.deviceInvalidPath: This device can't be written to. Select the device again.
error.deviceNotFound: The selected device is no longer connected. Reconnect it and select it again.
error.deviceChanged: The selected device changed since you picked it. Select it again before writing.
error.deviceReadOnly: The device is write-protected. Slide the card's lock switch off and try again.
error.deviceSystemBlocked: This is a system drive. Turn on "Allow system drives" in Settings to write to it.
error.deviceTooSmall: The image needs {{needed}} but the device holds only {{available}}. Use a larger device.
error.qdlDeviceNotFound: The selected EDL device is no longer connected. Reconnect it in EDL mode and select it again.
error.qdlMultipleDevices: Several EDL devices are connected and the selected one can't be identified. Connect only the board you want to flash.

armbian.description: This device is running Armbian. Want to pre-select this board and skip the manual steps?
armbian.cancelHint: If you cancel, board auto-detection turns off.

settings.title: Settings

settings.developerModeDescription: Enable verbose logging and debug info

settings.forceOfflineDescription: Always work offline: skip the connectivity check and use only local and cached images.

notifications.showUpdaterModalDescription: Notify you when an update is available
notifications.showWelcomeDescription: Show the welcome screen when the app starts

cache.maxSizeDescription: Removes the oldest images automatically once the size limit is reached
cache.clearDescription: Remove all cached data to free up space
cache.clearConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete all cached data? This cannot be undone.
cache.manageDescription: View, delete, or reuse cached images
cache.deleteConfirmAll: Delete all {{count}} cached images for this board?

autoconfig.title: Autoconfig profiles
autoconfig.description: Preset the Armbian first-boot setup. A profile is applied only when you select it before flashing.
autoconfig.emptyHint: Create a profile to preset network, locale and accounts on first boot.
autoconfig.localeRequiresUser: Locale and timezone only apply when you create a user, so fill in the username, password and full name first.
autoconfig.keyUrlInvalid: Enter a URL to the public key (e.g. https://github.com/username.keys), not the key itself
autoconfig.urlInvalid: Enter a valid URL (http or https)
autoconfig.ipNotHost: This is the network or broadcast address of the subnet, not a usable device address. Pick one like 192.168.1.50
autoconfig.gatewayInvalid: Enter a valid IPv4 address for the gateway (e.g. 192.168.1.1)
autoconfig.gatewayOutsideSubnet: The gateway must be in the same subnet as the IP address
autoconfig.gatewaySameAsIp: The gateway can't be the device's own address
autoconfig.dnsInvalid: Enter IPv4 addresses separated by spaces or commas (e.g. 8.8.8.8 1.1.1.1)
autoconfig.secretWarning: Passwords are stored and written to the image in plain text.
autoconfig.userHint: Leave the username empty and Armbian will still ask you to create a user on first boot.
autoconfig.previewEmpty: Nothing set yet. Fill in the fields above to build the first-boot file.
autoconfig.wifiKeyLength: Wi-Fi passwords usually have 8 to 63 characters

wizard.nameHint: Every next step is optional. Skip what you do not need.
wizard.ssidRequired: Type the network name, or pick Cable.
wizard.addressRequired: Type the address, or pick Automatic.
wizard.usernameRequired: Type a username, or pick At first login.
wizard.keyUserInvalid: That is not a valid username.

name.title: What should we call it?
name.sub: You pick it by name on the summary.

network.title: How does it connect?
network.sub: You can change it later in Settings.
network.cableLine: Plug the cable in before the first start. The board gets its address from your router.

user.title: Who logs in?
user.sub: The account you use on the board, for login and for sudo.
user.laterLine: The first time you log in, over SSH or with a keyboard and monitor, Armbian asks you to create it. The language and time from this profile are not applied then.

locale.title: Language and time
locale.sub: Applied when the board creates your user.
locale.locationLine: Armbian sets the language and time zone from where the board connects to the internet.
locale.userComplete: Your user is complete, so Armbian applies these.
locale.userIncomplete: Armbian applies these only when the profile creates a user with a password and a full name.

access.title: How do you get in?
access.sub: SSH keys let you log in without typing a password.
access.fetchHint: The board fetches them at first start.
access.linkHint: Any https address that serves public keys, one per line.
access.passwordLine: You log in with your password, over SSH or with a keyboard and monitor.
access.rootHint: Leave it empty and Armbian asks you to change it at first login.

review.title: Ready to create {{name}}
review.sub: Check it once. Then it is selected on the summary.
review.subSettings: Check it once. Then it shows in your profile list.
review.later: You can change it any time in Settings, Autoconfig.

update.title: Update Available
update.readyMessage: The update is downloaded. Restart the app to finish installing.
update.errorMessage: Failed to download the update. Please try again later.
update.errorNotInApplications: Please move the app to the Applications folder and try again.
update.changelogErrorHint: Check that you're online and that the version exists on GitHub.
